supporting_pages.title: "Restricting OAuth scope to read-only for Google BigQuery connections \_\
evidence_snippets: Prior to Looker 24.20, when OAuth authentication for Google BigQuery connections were being set up , Looker created OAuth credentials that allowed the database user to request read and write scope.
Google BigQuery connections that are configured for OAuth authentication do not support query killing .

evidence_snippets: If you are not logged in to your OAuth user account when you test one of these connections, Looker will show a warning with a Log In link.
Database connections that use OAuth, such as Snowflake and Google BigQuery , require a user login.
SSH connections to PrestoDB or Trino databases may require additional database configuration.
